notes: The Mana engine ECU is the shared IAW 5AM; this entry is the separate CVT controller. A published PADS K-Line capture proves KWP2000 physical addressing to target 0xEC from tester 0xF1 and records the two learning commands exactly: IOControl 30 02 08 (belt replacement) followed by 30 01 08 (pulley-potentiometer reset). ManaTCU V1.03 was built from those captures, includes SecurityAccess, and has been field tested. Identification, fault-request and live-data wire definitions were not published, so this workstation does not guess them. The two captured routines remain unavailable because they require security access plus motorcycle-specific conditions (engine running, rear wheel free, side stand up, ordered execution) that the current safety state cannot verify.

kline.note: Captured traffic establishes tester 0xF1 and TCU 0xEC addressing. Baud rate and initialization are not claimed because the capture begins after session bring-up.

session.physical_blocked_reason: The raw capture establishes physical addresses and two routine payloads, but not the complete initialization, session, security access, or safe read services.
session.note: Captured KWP routine frames do not establish initialization, session selection, or security sequencing.

identification.reason: ManaTCU displays BIN/TCU versions, but the request and response layout were not published in the available capture.

memory.write_blocked_reason: ManaTCU V1.03 accesses this controller after a four-byte SecurityAccess exchange, but neither its key algorithm nor memory-transfer sequence is public in source form.
